testcase.name: wrongAnswerRoutesRetainTheCorrectedObjectiveExplanation

failure.message:
org.junit.ComparisonFailure: u21-st-rem-purpose expected:<чтобы [is an ordinary purpose conjunction. The bookish or archaic qualifier in the retained source belongs to дабы, not to чтобы. The English meaning so that differs from the conditional if and the causal because. Select the meaning of the displayed conjunction; do not infer an archaic register for the ordinary form].> but was:<чтобы [— so that. если — if. The first conjunction can introduce a purpose; the second introduces a condition. In a purpose construction with the same subject for both actions, an infinitive after the purpose conjunction can name the intended action. This rule is explained here, but the current choices do not require composing such a sentence.
чтобы is an ordinary purpose conjunction. The bookish or archaic qualifier in the retained source belongs to дабы, not to чтобы. The English meaning so that differs from the conditional if and the causal because. Select the meaning of the displayed conjunction; do not infer an archaic register for the ordinary form.
потому что — because. хотя — although. The first gives a reason; the second introduces a concession. The English label after names a temporal relationship rather than a reason. English since can also express a reason, so it is not a contrasting wrong answer to because in this exercise. The causal check instead contrasts because with although and after. These conjunction meanings are distinct from purpose and condition].>
